items.title: Monorepo and shared platform foundations
acceptanceCriteria: Strict TypeScript monorepo builds, lints and type-checks
Shared contracts, configuration, logging and Nest infrastructure exist without shared business logic

items.title: Local runtime infrastructure
acceptanceCriteria: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, Keycloak, MinIO and Temporal have reproducible local definitions
Service databases are independently provisioned

evidence.note: Runtime and live-verification evidence is recorded

items.title: Tenant isolation, authentication and authorization foundation
acceptanceCriteria: JWT validation and tenant context are enforced
Positive and negative authorization and tenant-isolation paths are tested

items.title: CI, security scans and container verification
acceptanceCriteria: Quality, security, integration and E2E jobs run on main
Every current service image is built and scanned without Critical or High findings

evidence.note: All main jobs and seven image scans passed

items.title: Formal backlog and Story Point progress control
acceptanceCriteria: A canonical validated backlog calculates MVP and full-product progress
CI rejects invalid or stale progress data
Governance prevents unverified work from earning points

items.title: Identity service core
acceptanceCriteria: OIDC, membership, roles and active-organization flows meet the documented contracts
Identity isolation, authorization and API paths are tested

items.title: Organization service core
acceptanceCriteria: Organization hierarchy and membership-facing contracts are implemented
Tenant-scoped CRUD and subtree visibility are tested

items.title: API gateway core
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated routes proxy with correlation, tenant context and circuit breaking
Unavailable upstreams fail with the platform error contract

evidence.note: Gateway unit and E2E paths passed

items.title: Asset service core and dossier
acceptanceCriteria: Assets have organization-agnostic identity and an explicit lifecycle
The dossier projection is idempotently built from events

evidence.note: Asset lifecycle and event projection are verified

items.title: Fleet assignment, usage and availability core
acceptanceCriteria: Assignment exclusivity is enforced by the database
Usage and availability flows are tenant-scoped and event-driven

evidence.note: Fleet code, tests and live E2E verification completed

items.title: Maintenance schedules, requests, repair orders and costs
acceptanceCriteria: Due state is derived from time and usage triggers
Request and repair-order lifecycles, concurrency-safe costs and approval events are verified

evidence.note: Maintenance tests and image verification passed

items.title: Economic core: wallet, ledger, payment abstraction, commission and reward
acceptanceCriteria: Ledger journals remain balanced and immutable
Hold, settlement, mock payment, configurable commission and capped reward flows are idempotent

evidence.note: Economic E2E, integration and 90 percent branch coverage passed

items.title: Marketplace catalogue, offers, orders and Temporal saga
acceptanceCriteria: Catalogue, offer and order lifecycles are tenant-safe and server-priced
Order saga integrates hold, confirmation, dispute and settlement without automatic confirmation

evidence.note: Marketplace coverage, integration, E2E and image gates passed on main

items.title: Activate the economic-service coverage gate in CI
acceptanceCriteria: The documented coverage command exists and measures a non-empty source set
CI enforces the existing economic thresholds without lowering them

items.title: Document service and secure object storage flows
acceptanceCriteria: Uploads validate real content type and size before object storage
Tenant-scoped signed access and document metadata are audited

items.title: Supplier qualification and performance core
acceptanceCriteria: Qualification and suspension are explicit, tenant-safe workflows
Configurable performance scoring supplies marketplace rating without invented verification

items.title: Inventory, reservation and forward logistics core
acceptanceCriteria: Stock movement and reservation are concurrency safe
Shipment state is visible without sharing another service database

items.title: Procurement demand aggregation, RFQ and purchase orders
acceptanceCriteria: Demand aggregation executes in the backend with configured windows and thresholds
RFQ confidentiality, evaluation and purchase-order issuance are auditable

items.title: Notification service with in-app and email delivery
acceptanceCriteria: Domain events produce idempotent in-app notifications
Email delivery respects user preferences and records delivery outcome

items.title: Append-only audit service
acceptanceCriteria: Every state-changing action can be traced to actor, time, origin and correlation
Audit records are append-only and object-authorized

items.title: Base insurance registry and claim history
acceptanceCriteria: Policy registry and expiry events are operational
A base claim has tenant-safe status history and documents without claiming insurer integration

items.title: Commission business-line policies
acceptanceCriteria: Parts, insurance, maintenance, logistics, procurement, construction and marketplace service commissions use versioned configurable rules
No commission rate is hard-coded

items.title: Participation breakdown and basic user levels
acceptanceCriteria: ParticipationScore is explained separately from spendable RewardPoints
Basic levels and badges use versioned rules and avoid coercive game mechanics

items.title: Construction project and configurable approval core
acceptanceCriteria: Projects, needs and progress reports follow explicit lifecycles
Approval authorities come from configuration and never create a new legal authority

items.title: Tender publication, confidential bids and evaluation
acceptanceCriteria: Tender deadlines survive restarts and late bids are rejected
Bid confidentiality and configurable evaluation are independently testable and auditable

items.title: Contract, statement and split approval lifecycle
acceptanceCriteria: Tender award creates a contract draft through a contract boundary
Technical and financial approvals are separate and settlement remains financially consistent

items.title: Production web foundation and design system
acceptanceCriteria: Production web uses documented tokens and accessible components
RTL, Persian dates and empty, loading and error states are verified

items.title: Identity, organization, asset, fleet and maintenance web surfaces
acceptanceCriteria: Core operational workflows are usable at documented permissions
Desktop and supported mobile viewports pass accessibility and tenant-isolation E2E

items.title: Economic and marketplace web surfaces
acceptanceCriteria: Wallet, order, dispute and settlement states match implemented backend contracts
No UI claims real banking, automatic confirmation or unimplemented supplier capabilities

items.title: Supply-chain and construction web surfaces
acceptanceCriteria: Procurement, supplier, logistics, construction and contract screens follow real APIs
Permission, conflict, empty and degraded states are covered

items.title: PWA and offline usage queue
acceptanceCriteria: Usage can be queued offline and synchronized idempotently
Conflict, retry and user-visible failure behavior are tested

items.title: Analytics read models and governed dashboards
acceptanceCriteria: Analytics projections are event-driven and tenant-safe
Governance views are aggregate-only and missing baselines report INSUFFICIENT_BASELINE

items.title: Staging deployment and production-shaped security
acceptanceCriteria: A reproducible staging deployment uses default-deny network policy
Secrets, migrations, image provenance and rollback are operationally verified

items.title: Performance, observability, backup and restore hardening
acceptanceCriteria: Load, trace, alert and runbook gates meet documented thresholds
A real restore proves data availability and ledger balance

items.title: Controlled pilot and go/no-go decision
acceptanceCriteria: Pilot scope and exit criteria are approved without invented numbers
Critical workflows, operational support and baseline KPIs are evaluated with real pilot users

items.title: Base reverse-logistics workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Return request, reverse transport, inspection and disposition use explicit states
Refund remains owned by economic-service and repeated events are idempotent

items.title: Commercial insurance quotation, comparison and issuance
acceptanceCriteria: Insurer integrations are isolated behind contracts and do not imply unapproved legal authority
Quotation, comparison, renewal and issuance are auditable

items.title: Commercial claims and insurer settlement
acceptanceCriteria: Claim assessment and settlement follow approved insurer and legal contracts
Commission and accounting entries remain configurable and auditable

items.title: Peer-group ranking and transparent participation score
acceptanceCriteria: Ranking compares only approved peer groups and exposes score reasoning
Low participation never removes essential product access

items.title: Reward benefits, campaigns and appeal workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Benefits and campaigns use versioned rules with caps
Users can inspect and appeal scoring decisions with an audit trail

items.title: Warranty, repair, replacement, recycling and disposal
acceptanceCriteria: Disposition policies cover warranty, repair, replacement, recycling and disposal
Custody, inventory, refund and audit boundaries stay independently owned

items.title: Telematics ingestion and device management pilot
acceptanceCriteria: Device identity and telemetry ingestion are tenant-safe and provider-neutral
Pilot hardware, retention and operational thresholds are approved before production use

items.title: GPS, usage and approved fuel analytics
acceptanceCriteria: Telemetry projections do not overwrite authoritative asset or fleet records
Fuel capability is absent unless explicitly approved

items.title: Real payment-provider integration
acceptanceCriteria: A legally approved provider is implemented behind the existing abstraction
Reconciliation, failure recovery and financial-security controls are independently verified

items.title: National-system integrations and digital signature
acceptanceCriteria: Each approved external system has a versioned contract and failure-isolation policy
Digital-signature authority is legally approved before implementation

items.title: Native mobile applications
acceptanceCriteria: Native apps consume existing APIs without creating parallel business rules
Offline, accessibility, device security and release operations are verified

items.title: Conditional extraction of logical services
acceptanceCriteria: Extraction occurs only after an ADR-044 trigger and migration ADR
Wallet, ledger, payment, commission, reward or insurance extraction preserves consistency and contracts

changeLog.reason: Create the first repository-backed roadmap baseline from documented scope and verified implementation evidence.
